notes: The presentative frame's *that* is given to the apodosis waw s008 under rule 45's second clause, so וַיְהִי keeps only *it was so*.
הַמִּשְׁתֶּה's article takes the possessive determiner *their* standing before its own word (rule 41), which leaves the *the* before *days* to the construct as a supplied one (rule 29).
The head of הִשְׁכִּים → *rose up early* is the one genuinely open choice; it is taken on the verb *rose* with the complement reading on *early* named in that unit (rules 8, 44).
כֻּלָּם is split as rule 19 directs: כֹּל keeps only *all* and the suffix takes the whole *of them*, headed on the pronoun.
כָּל־הַיָּמִים → *continually* meets rule 30's one-English-word condition, so its three morphemes share one unit headed on the noun.
